"The Ukrainian startup taking the missile fight deep into Russia" (Guardian) → technology. Fire Point: ~100 Flamingo cruise missiles/month + hundreds of drones/day, 18→6,000 employees since 2022, sustaining Ukraine's deep-strike campaign into Russia. 6. "Ways to think about token pricing" (Benedict Evans) → ai-tech. Long-form essay on whether frontier AI labs keep pricing power or become commodity infrastructure; 4 top-down framing questions.
